title: Linear Equations
description: Learn to solve linear equations step by step and apply them to real-world problems

definition.title: What is a Linear Equation?
definition.intro: A linear equation is a mathematical statement that shows two expressions are equal. The goal is to find the value of the variable that makes the equation true.
definition.explanation: Linear equations have variables raised to the power of 1 (not squared or cubed). When graphed, they form straight lines.
definition.goalText: Isolate the variable on one side of the equation to find its value. Think of it like unwrapping a present - remove one layer at a time!

balance.title: ⚖️ Balance Principle
balance.text: An equation is like a balanced scale. Whatever you do to one side, you must do to the other to keep it balanced.
balance.example: If you add 5 to the left side, add 5 to the right side too!

inverse.title: 🔄 Inverse Operations
inverse.text: To isolate the variable, use the opposite operation:

steps.title: 📋 Order of Operations (Reverse PEMDAS)
steps.step1: Simplify both sides (combine like terms, distribute)
steps.step2: Move variable terms to one side (add/subtract)
steps.step3: Move constant terms to the other side (add/subtract)

visual.title: Visual Guide: Types of Linear Equations

realWorld.title: Real World Applications
realWorld.intro: Linear equations help us solve everyday problems! Here's where you'll use them:

app1.title: 💰 Money & Budgeting
app1.description: Managing money often involves solving equations to find unknowns.
app1.example: You spent $45 on lunch and still have $120 left. How much money did you start with?

app2.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Age Problems
app2.description: Family relationships and age comparisons use linear equations.
app2.example: Your dad is 3 times your age. If he's 36 years old, how old are you?

app3.title: 🛍️ Shopping & Discounts
app3.description: Calculate original prices when you know the sale price and discount.
app3.example: A jacket is on sale for 25% off and costs $60 after discount. What was the original price?

exercises.title: Practice Exercises
exercises.instruction: Try solving these equations on your own. Click to reveal the solution when you're ready!

tip1.title: ⚠️ Always Check Your Answer
tip1.text: Substitute your solution back into the original equation to verify it works. This catches calculation errors!

tip2.title: ✅ Keep Equations Balanced
tip2.text: Whatever operation you perform on one side, do the same to the other side. The equals sign means both sides must remain equal.

tip3.title: ❌ Watch Out for Signs
tip3.text: Be careful with negative numbers! When subtracting a negative, it becomes addition. When dividing by a negative, the inequality flips (we'll learn more about this later).

tip4.title: 📝 Show Your Work
tip4.text: Write out each step clearly. This helps you track your thinking and makes it easier to find mistakes.

conclusion.title: Summary
conclusion.summary: Congratulations! You've learned how to solve linear equations, one of the most important skills in algebra.
conclusion.point1: Linear equations have variables to the first power
conclusion.point2: Use inverse operations to isolate the variable
conclusion.point3: Always maintain balance - do the same to both sides
conclusion.point4: Check your solution by substituting back into the original equation
conclusion.next: Next up: Inequalities - solving equations with 'greater than' and 'less than' symbols!
